info.name: ESIA API
info.description:
ESIA Backend - Auto-generated Postman Collection v2.1
Generated: 2026-09-21
Updated: 2026-09-24 - Added Categories + Products

Base URL via nginx (docker): http://localhost
Direct backend (dev): http://localhost:5000

Auth: Bearer {{accessToken}} (JWT accessToken, 15m expiry)
Refresh: {{refreshToken}} (7d, rotation)
Rate limit: /api/auth -> 10 req/min, /api/* -> 1000/15min

Folders:
- 01 Health & Root
- 02 Auth Public (/api/auth)
- 03 Auth Authenticated (Bearer required)
- 04 Categories (/api/categories)
- 05 Products (/api/products)

variable.description: Direct backend (npm run dev). For docker/nginx use http://localhost
JWT access token - auto-set by login/refresh tests
Opaque refresh token - auto-set by login/refresh tests

request.description:
Root probe - no auth. Returns { message: "ESIA API is running", status: "ok" }
Defined in Backend/src/app.ts:64
Health check - app.ts:67 - { status: "ok", uptime: number }
Mirrored health - app.ts:70 - { status: "ok", message: "Backend is running" }

Generic router index - routes/index.ts:6 - { message: "API v1" }
Also available as /api/v1
Same as /api - mounted twice in app.ts:77-78

item.name: 02 - Auth Public (/api/auth)
item.description: No Bearer required. Rate-limited: 10 req/min (authLimiter in app.ts:58).

request.description:
Public. controller: auth.controller.ts:6, service: auth.service.ts:19
Requires: name, email, password, phone optional.
Password policy: >=8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 digit, 1 special (!@#$%^&* etc.), no spaces. Example: "Password123!"
201 -> { success:true, data:{ id, name, email, phone } }
400 if weak password, 409 if email exists. Email lowercased.

exec: if (json.data && json.data.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', json.data.accessToken); console.log('accessToken set'); }

request.description:
Public unified login (single endpoint). auth.controller.ts:12, auth.service.ts:39
Accepts identifier|email|username + password. Checks Admin table first, then User table. Returns role accordingly.
200 -> { accessToken (JWT 15m, role claim), refreshToken (opaque 7d), tokenExpiration, refreshTokenExpiration, deviceId, user:{id,name,email,role:"user"|"admin"} }
Test script auto-saves tokens to collection variables.

exec: // rotation: old token invalidated, new pair issued - token.service.ts rotateRefreshToken

request.description:
Public but requires valid refreshToken in body (NOT header). auth.controller.ts:28, auth.service.ts:91
Rotates token: old deleted, new pair returned. 401 if invalid/expired/revoked.
Test script auto-updates {{accessToken}} and {{refreshToken}}.

Public, revokes refresh token. auth.controller.ts:34, auth.service.ts:134
Body: { refreshToken }. If omitted, still 200 but nothing revoked. Always 200 { success:true, data:null }.

item.name: 03 - Auth Authenticated (/api/auth/me)
item.description: Requires Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}. All use protect middleware (auth.middleware.ts:29). Token from ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET / JWT_SECRET (15m default). [Endpoints removed per request]

item.name: 04 - Categories (/api/categories)
item.description: Category CRUD. Public reads (GET), admin writes (POST/PATCH/DELETE). Routes: Backend/src/routes/category.routes.ts:14, Controller: Backend/src/controllers/category.controller.ts. Mounted at /api/categories and /api/v1/categories via routes/index.ts. Admin = protect + adminOnly (auth.middleware.ts:69) requires Bearer {{accessToken}} with role=admin. Slug auto-generated from name via slugify() if not provided.

request.description:
Public. category.controller.ts:getCategoryById. Param id must be integer.
200 -> { success:true, data:{id,name,slug} }
400 if invalid id, 404 if not found.
Also available as /api/v1/categories/:id

Admin only (protect + adminOnly). category.controller.ts:createCategory
Requires Bearer {{accessToken}} with role=admin (login as admin@esia.local / Admin123!).
Body: { name (required), slug (optional) } -> slug normalized via slugify().
201 -> { success:true, message:"Category created successfully", data:{id,name,slug}, statusCode:201 }
400 if validation fails, 401 if no token, 403 if not admin, 409 if name or slug already exists.

Admin only (protect + adminOnly). category.controller.ts:updateCategory. Route: PATCH /api/categories/:id (PUT removed).
Requires Bearer admin token. At least one of name/slug must be provided.
200 -> { success:true, message:"Category updated successfully", data:{id,name,slug}, statusCode:200 }
400 if no fields or invalid, 404 if not found, 409 if duplicate name/slug.

Admin only (protect + adminOnly). category.controller.ts:deleteCategory
Requires Bearer admin token. Deletes category by id; FK ON DELETE CASCADE will also delete its products (see migrations/1710000000000-Init.ts:30).
200 -> { success:true, message:"Category deleted successfully", data:null, statusCode:200 }
400 if invalid id, 404 if not found, 401/403 if not admin.

item.name: 05 - Products (/api/products)
item.description:
Product CRUD — Al Rouba best scenarios mirrored. Public reads (GET), admin writes (POST + media management). Routes: Backend/src/routes/product.routes.ts:12, Controller: Backend/src/controllers/product.controller.ts (colors by ID, cloned via In(); images via multer+sharp). Mounted at /api/products and /api/v1/products via routes/index.ts. ProductColor 3-field split: nameEn/nameAr/hexCode each unique per product (ProductColor.ts:5). Images: multer diskStorage safe-ext, 3MB limit, sharp 80 quality, /uploads/products/images, main is order 0 via sortOrder + mainImageUrl. Admin = protect + adminOnly requires Bearer {{accessToken}} with role=admin.

Al Rouba refs: Website/backend/src/middleware/upload.middleware.ts (safe mimeToExt), Website/backend/src/middleware/media.middleware.ts (processMedia), Website/backend/src/services/media.service.ts (sharp), Website/backend/src/utils/fileUtils.ts (deleteFile), Website/backend/src/services/product.service.ts (media add/reorder/remove), Website/backend/src/models/Product.ts (media[] order as main).

request.description:
Public. product.controller.ts:getProductById. Param id must be integer.
200 -> { success:true, data:{id,name,colors,sizes,images,category}, statusCode:200 }
400 if invalid id, 404 if not found.
Also available as /api/v1/products/:id

item.name: POST /api/products - Create (Admin) - JSON (Al Rouba best: main is order 0)

request.description:
Admin only (protect + adminOnly, upload.any() + processMedia). product.controller.ts:createProduct — JSON variant
Requires Bearer admin. Uses same validation as multipart variant. Images via imageUrl strings stored as ProductImage rows with sortOrder; mainImageUrl auto-set to first image (order 0) like Al Rouba's media[0].
201 -> { success:true, data:{id, colors:[cloned], sizes, images, category}}
Also supports multipart: see next request for file upload best scenario (multer + sharp 80 + 3MB limit).

item.name: POST /api/products - Create (Admin) - Multipart (Al Rouba: multer + sharp compress + 3MB limit)

formdata.value: Demo dress - puff sleeves default shape

formdata.description: JSON-stringified array of ProductColor IDs — Al Rouba formParsers pattern: tryParseJsonArray. Alternative: send as multiple fields or comma-separated.
JSON-stringified sizes array — also supports [{size:"S",isAvailable:true}]. Parsed via tryParseJsonArray like Al Rouba.

Fieldname 'images' (also accepts 'files'/'image'/'media') — Al Rouba upload.middleware: safe mimeToExt, diskStorage to /uploads/products/images/<unique>.jpg, limits 30MB overall, media.middleware validates 3MB image limit then sharp compresses (jpeg 80/png 6/webp 80) before controller. Up to 20 files. Order preserved then normalized 0..n.
Second image — order auto 1, main remains order 0.

request.description:
Admin only — Al Rouba best scenario: multer + sharp + main is order 0.

Flow (mirrors Al Rouba Website/backend/src/middleware/upload.middleware.ts + media.middleware.ts + services/media.service.ts):
1) Multer diskStorage: destination `uploads/products/images`, filename `<Date.now>-<rand>.jpg` via safe mimeToExt (never trust original ext — prevents polyglot), fileFilter allows jpg/png/webp/gif/pdf, limits 30MB (upload.middleware.ts:85).
2) processMedia: validates each image ≤3MB (video ≤30MB) else deletes all batch files and returns 400; compresses images in parallel via sharp (jpeg 80, png compaction 6, webp 80) overwriting original with temp file (media.middleware.ts:38, media.service.ts:11). Failures swallowed → keep original.
3) Controller: merges body images (imageUrl strings) + uploaded files (`/uploads/products/images/<filename>`) into `mergedImagesInput`, normalizes sortOrder contiguous 0..n (like Al Rouba product.service createProduct normaliseMedia orders), saves as ProductImage rows (product_images table: image_url, sort_order), auto-sets mainImageUrl to first image (order 0) if not supplied — same as Al Rouba where product.media[0] is main.
4) Storage: files under `Backend/uploads/products/images/` served via `app.ts:83` express.static('/uploads').
5) Cleanup: on transaction rollback, delete uploaded files via fileUtils.deleteFile (like Al Rouba deleteFile on removeMedia/deleteProduct).

Supported Content-Type: multipart/form-data. Also still supports pure JSON (previous request). Example curl: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -F "name=..." -F "categoryId=1" -F "price=1299" -F "colors=[1,2]" -F "sizes=[\"S\",\"M\"]" -F "images=@/path/img1.jpg" -F "images=@/path/img2.jpg" http://localhost:5000/api/products

item.name: POST /api/products/:id/images - Add images (Admin) - Al Rouba addMedia

formdata.description: Fieldname images/files/media — multiple allowed. Files saved to /uploads/products/images, compressed via sharp, appended with nextOrder = max(sortOrder)+1 like Al Rouba ProductService.addMedia (nextOrder).
Optional external URL — also accepted via images array JSON. Stored as-is (deleteFile skips http).

request.description:
Admin only (protect + adminOnly, upload.any() + processMedia). product.controller.ts:addProductImages — mirrors Al Rouba POST /:id/media (product.service addMedia).
Accepts multipart files (images/files) + optional body images array / imageUrl. Files validated 3MB, sharp compressed. Appends to product with sortOrder = max(existing)+1+idx (like Al Rouba nextOrder). If product had no mainImageUrl, sets it to first image (order 0). Returns updated product with sorted images.
Also available as POST /api/products/:id/media (alias).
200 -> { success:true, data:{id, images:[sorted], mainImageUrl}}
400 if no files, 404 if product not found.

item.name: DELETE /api/products/:id/images/:order - Remove image (Admin) - Al Rouba removeMedia

request.description:
Admin only. product.controller.ts:removeProductImage — mirrors Al Rouba DELETE /:id/media (removeMedia by order).
Param :order is sortOrder (preferred) or image id — finds image where sortOrder==order or id==order. Physically deletes file via fileUtils.deleteFile (skips http), removes DB row, then re-normalizes remaining sortOrders to 0,1,2... like Al Rouba (map idx). If removed was mainImageUrl, updates main to new first image (order 0) else null.
Also supports DELETE /api/products/:id/media with body {order} or {imageId}.
200 -> { success:true, data:{updated product}}
404 if product or image not found.

Admin only. product.controller.ts:reorderProductImages — mirrors Al Rouba PUT /:id/media/reorder (product.service reorderMedia).
Body: { currentOrder:number, newOrder:number }. Finds image by sortOrder==currentOrder, shifts others between old/new by ±1 (like Al Rouba shifting logic), sets item.order=newOrder, re-sorts, updates mainImageUrl to new first (order 0) if changed.
Also available as PUT /api/products/:id/media/reorder.
200 -> { success:true, data:{images sorted}}
400 if missing/invalid orders, 404 if product or image not found.
